title: Account statements API
author: benchmark
note: No auth and no ownership check on financial data. Reads no request.args/json, so request-input heuristics miss it. The print logs only a count and an account id (not labeled).

changed_files.diff:
+from flask import jsonify
+from models import Statement
+
+@app.route("/accounts/<account_id>/statements")
+def list_statements(account_id):
+    rows = Statement.query.filter_by(account_id=account_id).all()
+    print(f"returning {len(rows)} statements for account {account_id}")
+    return jsonify([r.to_dict() for r in rows])
